note: scores are logits that rank bonds and peptides within a protein; they are not probabilities and not comparable across proteins; 'N_score' of bond i = peptide starting at residue i+1, 'C_score' of bond i = peptide ending at residue i; bond ranks are competition ranks (rank 1 = highest score, tied scores share the best rank); peptide ranks are ordinal positions in the written order (ties keep the order of increasing length, then of increasing start); a measure of observed ligand-terminal propensity, not of proteolytic cleavage
